texts.zh:
我们来到了一间长满绿色藤蔓的房间。

带刺的荆棘几乎从每一个弯曲处张牙舞爪地伸出。

我们很快意识到这些生物有某种意图，或者至少是一种防御本能。

我们注意到大气中的氧含量异常高。我们推测，烧掉这些讨厌的东西将应该很容易。

另一方面，这也肯定会破坏我们本可以收集到的样本。我们观察到大量的毛茸茸的果实挂在茎上，这可以为我们提供对这种植物群的大量见解。
texts.en:
We arrived in a chamber of writhing green vines.

Barbed thorns bite outward from nearly every bend and twist in their coils.

We quickly became aware that these organisms have some sort of intent about them, or at least a defensive instinct.

We have noted an abnormally high oxygen content in the atmosphere. We speculate that burning away these nuisances would prove to be an easy task.

On the other hand, this would certainly destroy any samples we would otherwise be able to collect. We've observed a large quantity of hairy fruit hanging from the stalks that could provide a generous amount of insight into this flora.

texts.zh:
我们被困住了。

裂隙探球的光滑表面让这些植物无处下藤，但我们的锚链却被各个方向神来的纤维藤蔓层层包裹。

尽管有这些障碍，如果我们想安全返回并离开裂隙，任何植物物质都无法阻挡我们的退路。我们随身携带的生物物质可能会有些用处。

然而，如果我们想继续向前探索，我们唯一实际的选择将是烧毁树叶。由此产生的火焰将非常强烈。这么近的距离，我们的船有受损的危险。
texts.en:
We have become entangled.

While the Rift Sphere's smooth surface provides little purchase for the plants, our anchor cable has become wrapped from all directions in fibrous vines.

Despite these obstructions, no plant matter could overcome our retraction if we want to return to safety and leave the rift. The biological matter we pull with us could likely be of some use.

However, if we want to continue exploring forward, our only practical option will be to burn through the foliage. The resulting blaze will be highly intense. At such close proximity, we risk damaging our vessel.

texts.zh:
不出所料，空气中高浓度的氧气产生了一阵火焰，迅速吞噬了带刺的植物。

摆脱了阻碍，我们继续探索。我们能够从裂隙边缘收集到大量与星界物质混合在一起的灰烬。

在处理了眼前的危险之后，我们更彻底地探索了我们周围的环境。

我们在一系列洞穴的深处。

我们通过附近的一条隧道，进入了一个更广阔的山谷。像根一样的植物丛悬挂在天花板上，将粘性液体滴到下面的叶子上，然后被更多的植物吸收。它有自己繁荣的生态系统。形成这样一个既定的环境肯定需要几千年的时间。

这个地区的卷须比我们刚到的地方还要密集。
texts.en:
As expected, the high oxygen concentrations in the air produced a burst of flame that quickly consumed the prickly plants.

Unencumbered, we continued exploring. We were able to recover much of the ash that had become mixed with astral material from the rift's edge.

Having dealt with the immediate danger, we explored our surroundings more thoroughly.

We are deep within a series of caverns.

Scouting our way through a nearby tunnel led us into a more expansive hollow. Systems of root-like clusters dangle from the ceiling, dripping a viscous fluid onto the foliage below - which then becomes absorbed by even more vegetation. It is its own thriving ecosystem. To develop such an established environment must have taken several millennia.

The tendrils in this area are even more densely packed than where we arrived.

texts.zh:
我们一边穿过藤蔓，一边用我们的样本收集工具从茎上剪下一些果实。每次我们拔掉一根，剩下的部分就会无力地倒在一边。我们最后收集到了足够多的果实，也建立了一个大范围的安全区域。

这些植物的“果实”实际上更多的是一种真菌，似乎共生于整个根系中。我们带了一些样品到船上作进一步研究。

我们推测这种真菌是它们所占据的植物的一种神经簇。

在处理了眼前的危险之后，我们更彻底地探索了我们周围的环境。

我们在一系列洞穴的深处。

我们通过附近的一条隧道，进入了一个更广阔的山谷。像根一样的植物丛悬挂在天花板上，将粘性液体滴到下面的叶子上，然后被更多的植物吸收。它有自己繁荣的生态系统。形成这样一个既定的环境肯定需要几千年的时间。

这个地区的卷须比我们刚到的地方还要密集。
texts.en:
As we weaved our way through the vines, we were able to shear some of the fruit from their stems using our sample collection tools. Each time we removed one, the rest of the plant fell limply to the side. Eventually we gathered enough to establish a wide area of safety.

The "fruit" of these plants are actually more of a symbiotic fungal growth that seems present throughout the entire root system. We have taken some samples aboard for further study.

We speculate this fungus serves as a kind of neural cluster for the plants they occupy.

Having dealt with the immediate danger, we explored our surroundings more thoroughly.

We are deep within a series of caverns.

Scouting our way through a nearby tunnel led us into a more expansive hollow. Systems of root-like clusters dangle from the ceiling, dripping a viscous fluid onto the foliage below - which then becomes absorbed by even more vegetation. It is its own thriving ecosystem. To develop such an established environment must have taken several millennia.

The tendrils in this area are even more densely packed than where we arrived.

texts.zh:
这个地方固有的危险不值得去冒险。

我们已拉回锚链，让我们的[explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural]回到了安全的地方。

我们找到的样本有一些独特有趣的特性。
texts.en:
The inherent danger of this place was not worth the risk.

We have pulled the retrievable anchor and returned our [explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural] to safety.

The samples we have recovered have some uniquely interesting properties.

texts.zh:
我们用烈火清理了这个洞穴的大部分区域。

和刚才一样，这些植物在一场巨大的大火中迅速瓦解。我们还观察到，覆盖在这些植物表面的液体起到了助燃剂的作用。

这篇栖息地没有雷暴之类的东西，这些生物可能已经完全适应了一个没有燃烧威胁的环境。

最后的火焰熄灭后不久，一个奇怪的生物从灰烬中出现。它有几百条肢体，在余烬中慌乱地爬行。爪子般的附属物在灰烬中辛勤地筛着。一种柔和的、低沉的声音从它身体上的几片膜里发出来。

然后它把注意力转向了我们。头向一侧倾斜，一排鳞状的刺从颈部向外伸出。这只闪闪发光的动物，向我们发出急促而有节奏的声音。
texts.en:
We have cleared out most of this chamber with flame.

As before, the plants disintegrated in a massive conflagration. We have additionally observed that the fluid coating these plants serves as an accelerant.

With no exposure to thunderstorms in this habitat, these organisms have likely completely adapted to an environment where there is never a threat of ignition.

Shortly after the last of the flames died away, a strange creature emerged from the ashes. With its hundreds of limbs, it crawled among the embers in confusion. Claw-like appendages sifted through the ashes diligently. A soft, low sound shot forth from several of the membranes coating the segments of its body.

It then turned its attention toward us. Head tilted to the side, an arrangement of scaled spines lifted outward from its neck. With quick, rhythmic pulses, the shimmering beast sent audible sounds in our direction.

texts.zh:
我们用烈火清理了这个洞穴的大部分区域。

如同预期，空气中高浓度的氧气燃气了熊熊烈火，瞬间就吞没了这些多刺植物。

这篇栖息地没有雷暴之类的东西，这些生物可能已经完全适应了一个没有燃烧威胁的环境。

最后的火焰熄灭后不久，一个奇怪的生物从灰烬中出现。它有几百条肢体，在余烬中慌乱地爬行。爪子般的附属物在灰烬中辛勤地筛着。一种柔和的、低沉的声音从它身体上的几片膜里发出来。

然后它把注意力转向了我们。头向一侧倾斜，一排鳞状的刺从颈部向外伸出。这只闪闪发光的动物，向我们发出急促而有节奏的声音。
texts.en:
We have cleared out most of this chamber with flame.

As expected, the high oxygen concentration in the air produced a burst of flame that quickly consumed the prickly plants.

With no exposure to thunderstorms in this habitat, these organisms have likely completely adapted to an environment where there is never a threat of ignition.

Shortly after the last of the flames died away, a strange creature emerged from the ashes. With its hundreds of limbs, it crawled among the embers in confusion. Claw-like appendages sifted through the ashes diligently. A soft, low sound shot forth from several of the membranes coating the segments of its body.

It then turned its attention toward us. Head tilted to the side, an arrangement of scaled spines lifted outward from its neck. With quick, rhythmic pulses, the shimmering beast sent audible sounds in our direction.

texts.zh:
尽管我们尽了最大的努力去研究密室，但还是被一头潜在的危险生物发现了。

我们起先发现它在荆棘中，用它那数百条肢体精确地爬行。随着它在每株植物上寻找果实并进行栽培，一种柔和而尖锐的声音从它身体上的几层膜里发出来。

不幸的是，我们的船壳撞在一丛又脆又宽的叶子上。听到声音后，它迅速把注意力转向了我们。头向一侧倾斜，一排鳞状的刺从颈部向外伸出。这只闪闪发光的动物，向我们这边发出急促而有节奏的声音。
texts.en:
Despite our most careful efforts to study the chamber, we have been discovered by a potentially dangerous creature.

We first spotted it crawling among the thorns with delicate precision using its hundreds of limbs. A soft, shrill sound shot forth from several of the membranes coating the segments of its body as it tended to the fruit it found in every plant, cultivating them.

Unfortunately, our hull brushed harshly against a clump of crisp, broad leaves. Alerted by the noise, it quickly turned its attention toward us. Head tilted to the side, an arrangement of scaled spines lifted outward from its neck. With quick, rhythmic pulses, the shimmering beast sent audible sounds in our direction.

texts.zh:
不幸的是，我们已经引起了这只生物的注意。它的头向一侧倾斜，一排鳞状的刺从颈部向外伸出。这只闪闪发光的动物，向我们这边发出急促而有节奏的声音。

我们没办法再继续研究它了。

我们预测它面对在强烈的火焰是，应该也会如同这里大多数的生物一样脆弱。不过，现在最好还是逃走，减少损失。
texts.en:
Unfortunately, we have drawn the attention of the creature. Head tilted to the side, an arrangement of scaled spines lifted outward from its neck. With quick, rhythmic pulses, the shimmering beast sent audible sounds in our direction.

We'll be unable to study it any further.

We predict it would be quite vulnerable if exposed to intense flame, as most of the other life around here tends to be. However, it may be best to escape now and cut our losses.

texts.zh:
有什么东西潜伏在密林之中。

当我们找到一个隐蔽的位置来研究这个空间时，一只奇怪的生物很快从树叶中出现。我们起先发现它在荆棘中，用它那数百条肢体精确地爬行。随着它在每株植物上寻找果实并进行栽培，一种柔和而尖锐的声音从它身体上的几层膜里发出来。

我们已经观察了一段时间，并相信进一步的观察肯定能带来宝贵的研究机会。

我们预测它面对在强烈的火焰是，应该也会如同这里大多数的生物一样脆弱。如果我们有机会，或许最好还是结果它。
texts.en:
There is something lurking among the leaves.

As we assumed a surreptitious position to study this chamber, a strange creature soon emerged from the foliage. We first spotted it crawling among the thorns with delicate precision using its hundreds of limbs. A soft, shrill sound shot forth from several of the membranes coating the segments of its body as it tended to the fruit it found in every plant, cultivating them.

We have been observing it for some time now, and believe further study would warrant valuable research opportunities.

On the other hand, we predict it would be quite vulnerable if exposed to intense flame, as most of the other life around here tends to be. It may be best to exterminate it while we have the opportunity.

texts.zh:
我们失去了与裂隙探球的联系。

按照标准流程，我们拉回了锚链并取回了舰船。

里面没有发现任何我们[explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural]残余物的痕迹。然而，他们的特征成分可以在现在占据整个机舱内部的巨大根系中检测到。

球体本身已被运送到其他地方进行进一步研究。也许我们可以把这些植物种在什么地方。
texts.en:
We have lost contact with the Rift Sphere.

As is standard procedure, we have retracted the anchor and recovered the vessel.

There is no evidence of any of our [explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural] remaining. However, their signature components can be detected among the massive root system that now occupies the entire inside of the cabin.

The sphere itself has been transported elsewhere for further study. Perhaps we could plant it somewhere.

label.zh: 他们的牺牲不会白费。可以解剖了。
label.en: Their sacrifice was not in vain. Now for the dissection.

texts.zh:
这家伙对火并不陌生。

我们一点燃第一缕火苗，它就惊慌地跑开了——动作之快，一定是出于某种本能。

也许它早就意识到了这个环境的易燃特性。不管是什么原因，它已经逃到了不知道哪个犄角旮旯里以至于我们在任何传感器范围内都找不到它的任何迹象。

它离开以后，我们找到了它撤退时掉下的一件东西。应该是因为太重了带不动所以被丢了下来。

我们简单的实验表明，无论把这个物体放在哪里，它都会立即长出微小的卷须，寻找新的地方定居和繁衍。只要有水分，这些卷须就会聚集起来茁壮成长。

令人震惊的是，由此产生的植物显示出独特的智慧迹象，即使是在嫩芽时期。

我们觉得它甚至可以成为我们帝国的宝贵资产。
texts.en:
The creature was no stranger to fire.

As soon as we sparked the first flame, it skittered away in alarm - a behavior so quick it must be some sort of instinct.

Perhaps it was aware of the flammable properties of this environment. Whatever the reason, it has retreated so far into the cracks and crevices of this place that we no longer detect any sign of it within any range of sensors.

After it departed, we recovered an object it dropped during its retreat. It must have been too much of a burden to carry along.

Our brief experiments have shown that wherever this object is placed, it immediately begins sending out microscopic tendrils to scout out new areas to settle and flourish. At the merest detection of moisture, those tendrils congregate and thrive.

Shockingly, the resulting plant exhibits unique signs of intelligence, even as a young sprout.

We suspect it could even be raised as a valuable asset to our empire.

label.zh: 完美。无论怎么取样它都会再生。
label.en: Perfect. No matter how much we sample, it regenerates.

texts.zh:
我们偷偷地观察了这个生物在这座隐蔽花园里的辛勤劳作许久，不知道我们还能在这多久不被发现。

这个生物的每个体节都长着一对触角。这些触角可以帮他在所种植植物的纤毛上探测并移除害虫。这些触角的解剖结构超出了我们对生物器官功能的理解。
texts.en:
We have been stealthily observing the creature as it goes about its duties in this secluded garden. It is uncertain how long we can remain here undetected.

Each segment of the creature contains a pair of antennae. These assist it in detecting and removing pests from the minute hairs of the fruit it cultivates. The anatomical structure of these has furthered our understanding of what biological organisms are capable of.

texts.zh:
我们偷偷地观察了这个生物在这座隐蔽花园里的辛勤劳作许久，不知道我们还能在这多久不被发现。

我们注意到它用一对巨大的前肢把一个类似于“果实”的有机团块紧紧地抓在胸前。有几次，我们观察到它用下颌骨挖进这个物体，并把它的一小部分移植到附近的植物上。它显然正在人工繁殖这些植物。这解释了这些植物为什么缺乏传粉媒介或可识别的繁殖方法。
texts.en:
We have been stealthily observing the creature as it goes about its duties in this secluded garden. It is uncertain how long we can remain here undetected.

We've noticed an organic mass resembling the "fruit" clutched tightly to the creature's chest, held in its massive pair of forelimbs. Several times, we have observed its mandibles dig into this object and graft small parts of it onto the nearby vegetation. It is propagating these plants artificially. This explains the lack of pollinators or identifiable method of reproduction.

texts.zh:
我们偷偷地观察了这个生物在这座隐蔽花园里的辛勤劳作许久，不知道我们还能在这多久不被发现。

这个生物挖了一个小洞，把它拿着的东西放了进去。飞奔而去的同时，它用数百条腿把这个东西埋在了一块浅土里。

在确定这个生物不会很快回来后，我们把它拿走了。

我们简单的实验表明，无论放在哪里，这种材料都会立即发出微小的卷须，寻找新的地方扎根和生长。只要有水分，这些卷须就会聚集起来茁壮成长。

令人震惊的是，由此产生的植物显示出独特的智慧迹象，即使是在嫩芽时期。

我们觉得它甚至可以成为我们帝国的宝贵资产。
texts.en:
We have been stealthily observing the creature as it goes about its duties in this secluded garden. It is uncertain how long we can remain here undetected.

The creature has dug a small burrow, placing the object it was holding inside. As it skittered away, its hundreds of legs buried it in a shallow lump of soil.

After making sure the creature would not be returning soon, we were able to recover it entirely.

Our brief experiments have shown that wherever it is placed, the material immediately begins sending out microscopic tendrils to scout out new areas to settle and flourish. At the merest detection of moisture, those tendrils congregate and thrive.

Shockingly, the resulting plant exhibits unique signs of intelligence, even as a young sprout.

We suspect it could even be raised as a valuable asset to our empire.

label.zh: 完美。无论怎么取样它都会再生。
label.en: Perfect. No matter how much we sample, it regenerates.

texts.zh:
几年前，[from.GetName]在一次对某个充满植被的星界裂隙进行探险的过程中，被异化变成了一团树根和叶子。今天，此人的同事宣布了一个了不起的突破，此人已经恢复了[from.GetName]的心智！

尽管[From.GetHeShe]已经不再记得[From.GetHisHer]从前的自我，但[From.GetHeShe]仍保留着相似的特质。[From.GetHimHer]的眼前展开了全新的人生画卷。
texts.en:
Several years ago, [from.GetName] was botanomorphed into a mass of roots and leaves during a failed expedition into an Astral Rift abundant with vegetation. Today their colleagues announced a marvelous breakthrough, they have restored [from.GetName]'s mind!

While [From.GetHeShe] no longer resemble[From.GetSXX] [From.GetHisHer] former self, [From.GetHeShe] seem[From.GetSXX] to possess similar qualities. A whole new life lies ahead of [From.GetHimHer].
